title: Privacy
intro: Tacticus Planner is an unofficial, open-source fan project for the game Tacticus. This page explains what the planner stores about you, why, and how to remove it.

signIn.title: Signing in
signIn.body: Sign-in is handled by Microsoft Entra External ID. The planner never sees your password. It keeps the sign-in identifier Microsoft returns, the planner name you choose, and when you last used the planner.

apiKey.title: Your Tacticus API key
apiKey.body: If you add a Tacticus API key, it is stored encrypted and used only to read your game and guild data from the Tacticus API. You can replace or remove it at any time in Account settings.

plannerData.title: Planner data
plannerData.body: To work across your devices, the planner stores your synced game data, goals, projects, event plans, guild data and settings on its server. A copy is kept in your browser's local storage so pages load quickly; signing out deletes that copy.

analytics.title: Analytics and error reports
analytics.body: Browsing without an account sends no analytics. For signed-in users of the production app, usage events and uncaught errors are sent to PostHog under a pseudonymous id. There is no autocapture or session replay, and the reports never include what you type into the planner, your email address or your planner name.

feedback.title: Feedback board
feedback.body: The feedback board is run on UserJot. If you open it while signed in, the planner identifies you to UserJot with a signed token for your planner account and planner name, so your posts and votes are attributed to you.

noSale.title: No ads, no selling
noSale.body: The planner shows no ads and does not sell or share your data with anyone beyond the services named on this page.

deletion.title: Deleting your data
deletion.body: You can delete your account and all of its planner data in Account settings, on the Account tab, with "Purge my account". This takes effect immediately and cannot be undone.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: Questions about this page or your data are welcome on our Discord server or on GitHub.
